classes.name: Animator
classes.doc: Plays animation tracks on the joints of the model it sits in (under a Humanoid or an AnimationController). Each step it blends the playing tracks by priority and weight and writes the result to the Motor6D joints' Transform. A script that writes a joint's Transform in the same frame wins over the Animator.

methods.name: LoadAnimation
methods.doc: Makes a track that plays the animation on this Animator's rig. The animation's id is resolved through the project's substitute table and the built-in clips; an unknown id gives an empty track and an RE9201 warning.

methods.name: GetPlayingAnimationTracks
methods.doc: The tracks playing now, in the order they started.

methods.name: StepAnimations
methods.doc: Advances every track by deltaTime seconds now and writes the joints, outside the normal step.

events.name: AnimationPlayed
events.doc: A track of this Animator started playing.

classes.name: Animation
classes.doc: Names an animation by its asset id, for Animator:LoadAnimation.

properties.name: AnimationId
properties.doc: The animation's asset id (rbxassetid://..., or a substitute key from real.toml).

classes.name: AnimationTrack
classes.doc: One animation loaded on an Animator: it plays, fades, loops and reports keyframes and markers.

properties.name: Animation
properties.doc: The Animation it was loaded from.

properties.name: IsPlaying
properties.doc: True from Play until Stop or the end of a non-looped animation.

properties.name: Length
properties.doc: The animation's length in seconds (0 for an empty clip).

properties.name: Looped
properties.doc: Whether it starts over at the end. Defaults to the clip's own setting.

properties.name: Priority
properties.doc: Its blending priority: a track of higher priority overrides lower ones on the joints it animates.

properties.name: Speed
properties.doc: The playback speed (1 is normal). Change it with AdjustSpeed.

properties.name: TimePosition
properties.doc: Where in the animation it is, in seconds.

properties.name: WeightCurrent
properties.doc: Its blend weight now, while fading in or out.

properties.name: WeightTarget
properties.doc: The weight it is fading to.

methods.name: Play
methods.doc: Starts playing, fading in over fadeTime seconds (0.1 by default) to weight (1) at speed (1).

methods.name: Stop
methods.doc: Fades out over fadeTime seconds (0.1 by default), then stops.

methods.name: AdjustSpeed
methods.doc: Changes the playback speed (1 by default); 0 holds the pose and a negative speed plays backward.

methods.name: AdjustWeight
methods.doc: Fades the blend weight to weight over fadeTime seconds.

methods.name: GetMarkerReachedSignal
methods.doc: A signal that fires with the marker's value each time playback passes a marker with this name.

methods.name: GetTimeOfKeyframe
methods.doc: The time of the first keyframe with this name. A name the clip lacks is an error.

events.name: Stopped
events.doc: The track stopped and faded out.

events.name: Ended
events.doc: A non-looped track reached its end.

classes.name: AnimationController
classes.doc: Holds an Animator for a model that has no Humanoid.

classes.name: KeyframeSequence
classes.doc: An animation made of keyframes, built in the place. A substitute table entry can point an animation id at one.

properties.name: Loop
properties.doc: Whether the animation loops by default.

properties.name: Priority
properties.doc: The default priority of tracks made from it.

classes.name: Keyframe
classes.doc: One moment of a KeyframeSequence: the poses of the joints at that time.

properties.name: Time
properties.doc: When the keyframe happens, in seconds from the start.

classes.name: Pose
classes.doc: The pose of one joint in a keyframe, named after the joint's Part1. Poses nest as the parts do.

properties.name: CFrame
properties.doc: The joint's Transform at this keyframe.

properties.name: Weight
properties.doc: How strongly the pose applies, from 0 to 1.

properties.name: EasingStyle
properties.doc: How the joint moves from this keyframe to the next.

properties.name: EasingDirection
properties.doc: Which end of the move the easing shapes.

classes.name: KeyframeMarker
classes.doc: A named marker on a keyframe; tracks fire their marker signal with its value.

properties.name: Value
properties.doc: The text passed to the marker signal.

classes.name: IKControl
classes.note: A two-bone solve for Position and Transform, and a look-at turn for LookAt and Rotation; no joint limits, pole weight or smoothing.
classes.doc: Bends a chain of joints so its end reaches a target. Sits under the Humanoid or AnimationController of a rig.

properties.name: Type
properties.doc: What to match: the target's position, rotation, both, or a look direction.

properties.name: ChainRoot
properties.doc: The first part of the chain (an upper arm).

properties.name: EndEffector
properties.doc: The part or attachment that should reach the target (a hand).

properties.name: Target
properties.doc: The part or attachment to reach.

properties.name: Pole
properties.doc: A part or attachment the chain bends toward.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: Whether it applies.

properties.name: Weight
properties.doc: How strongly it applies, from 0 to 1.

properties.name: Offset
properties.doc: An offset applied to the target.

properties.name: Priority
properties.doc: Order among IKControls of one rig: higher runs later.
